name: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (NASDAQ)
verdict: FLAT — dislocation premise dissolved; NOVEL bearish divergence stands (court 2026-08-19, adjudicated 2026-08-22)

adjudication_20260822.ruling: FLAT. No starter, no ladder, no price gate. The minimum-starter default does NOT attach: the kills are not risk/timing-only — the thesis's factual premise (an unexplained dislocation) was refuted on the tape, and the desk's own primary-sourced number diverges BEARISH from consensus.

kills.kill: Sequential-growth break vs street ramp: Q4 FY26 revenue (derived 1,335.12-898.11 = $437.0M) grew +7.4% QoQ after +51.9%, while consensus NTM EPS ~$6.15 vs FY26 $2.51 underwrites +145%. VERIFIED AT ADJUDICATION against SEC XBRL companyconcept (all four quarters + FY tie out).

Dislocation premise false: CRDO printed +8.82% on 8/17 before the -13.03% on 8/18; 2-session round-trip CRDO -5.36% vs control ALAB -5.65% — CRDO fell LESS. The anomaly lives in a one-bar window terminating on a giveback.

Book-level concentration: AI-interconnect inside the levered-AI-complex perimeter; a starter here adds to the exposure the XND hedge exists to offset, against the frozen p=0.45 AI-break. Taking the other side of the house view at 33x sales requires an explicit edge; none survives.
Valuation: 33x EV/S, 20% off a high reached after tripling; treasury sold $743M primary at these levels.

adjudication_20260822.red_kills_reduced: Red's SBC-basis FATAL was itself an asymmetric-basis artifact (blue applied it symmetrically: FN ex-SBC -0.7%, ALAB SBC/rev 18.8% vs CRDO 13.7% — ranking inverts in CRDO's favor; ratios re-checked at adjudication). Red's divergence kill counted analysts (coverage, not divergence). Right verdicts, wrong instruments — both REDUCED.
adjudication_20260822.staleness_condition: Tape moved -6.1% (245.97 bench anchor -> 231.01 on 8/21) — exceeds the 5% rule. Does NOT cure: the binding kill is the 9/01 print risk + sequential break, which no pre-print price cures. Ruling holds at any pre-print price.
adjudication_20260822.recourt_trigger: POST-print (2026-09-01 AMC) only, with the Q1 FY27 10-Q in hand. Binding re-entry test: sequential revenue >= +20% QoQ AND the $174M inventory build shown customer-committed. Condition-based, never a resting price gate.
work_queue: export_control_check flagged by BOTH benches as top open gap: 10-K named-customer/geographic revenue table vs BIS Entity List + SDN (Mainland China + HK facilities; a CN order-pause reproduces the observed Q4 shape). REQUIRED before any future CRDO court.
adjudication_20260822.conviction: 9/10 (both benches 8/10 same verdict on different instruments; load-bearing number re-verified against EDGAR at adjudication)
